instruction.text: Entscheide, ob es sich um direkte oder indirekte Rede handelt.

atoms.a: Rylie says that Biology was her favourite subject in school.
Mali told Zayn, “We are going to clean the beach on Saturday.”

instruction.text: Wähle den passenden Satz in der indirekten Rede aus.

b: Bill said that he is late.
Bill said that he is being late.
++Amelia said that she had been ill.
Amelia said that she was ill.
Amelia said that she has been ill.

atoms.a: Jake said, “I am listening to music.”
b: ++Jake said that he was listening to music.
Jake said that he is listening to music.
Jake said that he had been listening to music.

atoms.a: Willow told Mila, “I was looking at an eagle when you arrived.”
b: ++Willow told Mila that she had been looking at an eagle when she arrived.
Willow told Mila that she was looking at an eagle when she arrived.
Willow told Mila that she had looked at an eagle when she arrived.

atoms.a: Penny said, “We have just eaten breakfast.”
b: ++Penny said they had just eaten breakfast.
Penny said they have just eaten breakfast.

atoms.a: Isabella said, “We have been looking at paintings.”
b: ++Isabella said that they had been looking at paintings.
Isabella said that they have been looking at paintings.
Isabella said that they had looked at paintings.
